text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't reach it.
Even though what I aimed for was right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's so frustrating... Even though the fans and Trainer are doing everything they can to support me...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What was lacking was me.
Just my own lack of effort..."
choice_data_list: Then let's work hard together until it's enough!
So, what should we do after this?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Yes, that's right! Until it's enough...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Just 'trying my best' isn't enough.
To take that final step and seize victory—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll do my best!
Starting tomorrow, I won't go easy on myself—
I'll train harder and harder!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make sure to live up to everyone's expectations.
This time for sure!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's simple! I just have to do my best!
All I need to do is keep looking forward!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Alright! As soon as we get back,
we're doing even tougher training—
choice_data_list: Let's polish up the tactical side too!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right...!
I was only thinking about training my legs.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. In order to win the race,
I should've thought about that too... I was being short-sighted."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, I'm going to read a lot of
race strategy books. —I won't let you see
such a pathetic run from me ever again."
